text: Qualified nonlinear cost and protected the linear path. The production matrix-free patch operator matched an independent explicit gather/project/scatter plus basis-transpose oracle exactly for K=32/64/128 with U=1024 and 512 27-sample patches. Every product used zero interpolation, zero gradient evaluation and zero production dense-normal bytes; retained image evidence was 354304 B and explicit O(U*K) basis-table budgets were 311296/573440/1097728 B. A 134-D 1e-6..1e6 diagonal stress solve improved from IterationLimit at 512 iterations/514 products/residual 0.9904 to Converged at 1 iteration/3 products/residual 1.17e-10 using a 1072 B diagonal preconditioner. Added a production PE inverse/output factorial for K=32/64/128/256 and 8^3/16^3 targets: all outputs had full validity, one final interpolation pass, exactly U source evaluations, 40 B/U accounted incremental memory, and max analytic error 2.67e-15; inverse-coordinate medians ranged 5.82-19.75 ms at U=512 and 27.29-156.57 ms at U=4096. Repeated the exact six-phase linear JMH and cost probes: rigid/affine counters remain zero nonlinear coefficients and zero curvature products; all allocation measurements stayed within 0.688% of the sealed court and timings showed no regression signal. The 27x12 hot-loop gate remains 24 B at 2000 and 20000 iterations.
